instructions:
Upload each asset by POSTing to the submitUrl. You can POST the upload URLs in parallel. You can use either format:
1. multipart/form-data with a 'file' field (PREFERRED — the filename from the upload is used as the layer name in Figma)
2. Raw bytes with the correct Content-Type header (e.g. image/png, image/jpeg)

Supported types: image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif, image/webp, image/svg+xml. SVGs (image/svg+xml) are imported as editable vector node trees; nodeId, nodeIds, and scaleMode do not apply to them. Each URL is single-use and expires after 10 minutes. The response from each POST will contain the imageHash and placement details.
